selection_meaning: Best available raw return per view; does not indicate approval or brief compliance.
notes: One initial generation and one corrective regeneration per view. No image resizing, alpha replacement, compositing or other postprocessing. Only copies of raw tool returns saved. Built-in tool returned 1254x1254 despite explicit 1024x1024 requests. Exact guide silhouettes and strict flat albedo were not achieved.
